description: GoalPanel renders the session goal text, status chip, and recursive task tree in the session detail view info tab
testIds: GoalPanel renders nothing when goal is null
GoalPanel renders nothing when goal is undefined
GoalPanel renders goal text when goal is set
GoalPanel truncates long goal text at 120 chars and shows expand toggle
GoalPanel renders task fraction when tasks are set
GoalPanel shows correct status chip label for status=idle
GoalPanel shows correct status chip label for status=working
GoalPanel shows correct status chip label for status=blocked
GoalPanel shows correct status chip label for status=done
GoalPanel renders task tree from tasksJson
GoalPanel renders nested tasks with indentation
GoalPanel falls back to fraction when tasksJson is invalid JSON
GoalPanel falls back to fraction when tasksJson is empty string
